title: ext.adtype='popup' hint with a bare landing URL as adm, shown as inert text

source.name: ortbtools Core pop-family ext-hint recognition contract (packages/core/non-iab-formats.js STRING_HINT_KEYS, packages/core/rules/pop-request/index.js, packages/core/rules/pop-response/index.js) layered on IAB OpenRTB 2.x Imp/ext extensibility — the product's own documented, in-repo mechanism for pop/clickunder signalling, not a named vendor's wire format
source.version: repo HEAD at session start, commit a61fc25
source.license: Internal product code (ortbtools); no third-party material copied. MIT for the original fixture values.
source.notes: Same mechanism as pop-x-openrtb-adtype-popunder-window-open, with the 'popup' string value and a bare-URL adm instead of a window.open script.

modifications: All IDs, domains, prices and timestamps independently authored.
device.ip uses TEST-NET 192.0.2.44; user.id is a clearly synthetic string.
advertiser.example.test / tracking.example.test / publisher.example.test are reserved .test hosts; no live host, tracker or subscriber identifier.
provenance.sanitized: No real visitor or subscriber data. IP 192.0.2.44 is TEST-NET-1; every identifier is a synthetic-fixture string; every URL uses a reserved .test hostname.

pairApplicability.note: A genuine oRTB auction pair: the response bid references the offered impression, ids match, and the ext hint is a Core-recognized, non-vendor-attributed extension convention, not a proprietary wire wrapper.

device.ua: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36

specNotes: packages/core/non-iab-formats.js STRING_HINT_KEYS recognizes imp.ext.adtype='popup' the same way as 'popunder' — both normalize into the same POP_FORMAT_NAMES family (non-iab-formats.js:30).

A bare `https://` landing URL with no surrounding markup is the FIRST of the three accepted pop adm shapes documented in packages/core/rules/pop-response/index.js's header comment — the SSP wraps it in window.open at render time. admLooksLikePop's bare-URL branch must accept it.

public/modules/inspector/creative-classify.js classifies a bare absolute http(s) URL with nothing else in the body as kind='url' and shows it as inert text, never fetched or followed — this is the correct, documented preview contract for URL-shaped adm (specs/012-creative-preview-repair/contracts/creative-preview.md).
packages/core/crosscheck.js's pop-landing rule extracts the landing host directly from the bare-URL adm (the 'direct URL' branch of extractPopLandingHost) and must match bid.adomain.
Browser preview must not open a real popup or dispatch tracking — showing the URL as text, never navigating to it, satisfies that.
notes: Plain `iab` dialect, deliberately not the `ext-rtb` vendor dialect used by the sibling EXADS/Kadam/PPCmate/Adon3 pop cases.
